segments.text: Thirdly, In receiving Christ come empty handed unto him: believing in him that justifies the ungodly, Rom. 4. 5. and know that the deepest sense of your own vileness, emptiness, and unworthiness is the best frame of heart that can accompany you to Christ: many persons stand off from Christ for want of fit qualifications, they are not prepared for Christ as they should be, (i. e.) they would not come naked, and empty, but have something to commend them to the Lord Jesus for acceptance. O this is the pride of mens hearts, and the snare of the Devil: let him that hath no money come: you are not to come to Christ because you are qualified, but that you may be qualified with whatever you want, and the best qualification you can bring with you, is a deep sense that you have no worth nor excellency at all in you.
